Ordered the Stands for the long Dragons, and they look sweet.  Having the stands seperate gives a nice display area, but also allows the Dragons to be used in different ways with how flexible the Dragon are.  A very nice addition to the dragons!

The display stands for the long Dragons are pretty neat idea, lets you have a proper appearance but still allows the Dragons themselves to be used in different poses.  I'm glad I ordered the displays as well, it really compliments the cool Dragons.

This was the second Dragon I purchased in contrasting colors with display stands.  Very cool, and the 'Surprise Me' Eyes were a nice choice by the designer.   They look great displayed next to some swords under the TV.  A unique piece of decoration that can be moved and adjusted with how flexible they are.

Ordered 2 Dragons, and 2 of the Display bases.  Contrasting colors to each other and they look pretty sweet.  They are very flexible as expected for printed materials, and they looks very nice with no noticeable printer nozzle bumps.  They are quite large compared to other printed dragons I purchased at Con's, and look great displayed next to a couple swords on the TV stand. :-)
